description: Current inventory of top-level files and directories directly under astrid/. This is a documentation artifact, not a runtime input.

classification_categories.public_facade: Part of the public SDK contract.
classification_categories.service_composition: Product service declarations for the Runtime supervisor.
classification_categories.chat_service: Bundled agent chat service and its authored sources.
classification_categories.installer: Product installation, service setup, and upgrade tooling.

top_level_files.name: __main__.py
top_level_files.notes: Executable package gateway; delegates to astrid.core.gateway.main().

top_level_files.name: mcp_server.py
top_level_files.notes: MCP stdio server exposing Astrid's product commands as tools (python -m astrid.mcp_server).

top_level_files.name: services.py
top_level_files.notes: Concrete shell-free service argv and environment declarations for Runtime-managed pack-host and chat services.

top_level_directories.name: chat
top_level_directories.notes: Agent-owned chat service, bundled release artifact, and source tests.

top_level_directories.name: core
top_level_directories.notes: Framework kernel, contracts, runtime, integrations, generation/model catalog, timelines, packs, tasks, and shared libraries.

top_level_directories.name: installer
top_level_directories.notes: Cross-platform installer CLI, dependency provisioning, and service management.

top_level_directories.name: packs
top_level_directories.notes: Pack data only. Top-level Python modules are rejected except __init__.py.

top_level_directories.name: skills
top_level_directories.notes: Agent skill discovery, registry, and harness runtimes.

structure_constants_reference.rule: Top-level files are the public SDK facade, package CLI entrypoint, and Runtime service composition. Implementation belongs under astrid/core/, astrid/chat/, astrid/installer/, astrid/sdk/, or astrid/skills/ according to its declared purpose; astrid/packs/ holds pack content. Package-local docs and compatibility shims are rejected. Repository documentation belongs under root docs/.

pack_layout.rule: New pack machinery and schemas belong in astrid/core/pack/*. astrid/packs/ is for pack data only.
